title: India High-Altitude Defence Technology Ecosystem Atlas
subtitle: R&D, operational adaptation, testing, indigenous capability and emerging industrial opportunities
scope_note: The Atlas maps the documented high-altitude defence technology ecosystem. It does not assume a formal High Altitude Defence Corridor exists.

evidence_policy.rule: A means the source directly documents the stated claim. It does NOT mean deployed, mature, indigenous, procured or commercially successful.
Use for leads where a primary source is not yet available. Do not publish as hard fact without corroboration.
Research lead only; requires primary-source verification.
Analytical inference/opportunity hypothesis; never present as source-documented fact.

categories.definition: Energy generation, storage, thermal management and remote power
Drones, logistics UAS, difficult-terrain autonomy and payloads
Rugged electronics, RF, communications, sensors and computing
Heating, insulation, shelters, water and waste
Acclimatisation, clothing, footwear, oxygen, nutrition and physiology
Roads, vehicles, fuels, lubricants, maintenance and logistics
Cold-resistant polymers, composites, materials and fabrication
Food production, hydroponics, water management and local sustainment
Environmental testing, trials, qualification and ruggedisation
Inno-Yoddha, DRDO ToT, iDEX, TDF, startups and MSMEs
